content: {"like":["Values strong performances and direction, especially from actors like Leonardo DiCaprio and directors like Martin Scorsese.","Prefers realistic, grounded storytelling that portrays protagonists as relatable survivors rather than larger-than-life heroes.","Appreciates tight, heartfelt, and clever writing that brings characters to life.","Enjoys films that avoid clichés and deliver depth in character development.","Seeks narratives that resonate emotionally and intellectually without relying on superficial gimmicks."],"dislike":["Dislikes films that waste time, feel shallow, or lack genuine value, especially those that present Hollywood as a soulless, vapid machine.","Rejects stories that are thin, predictable, or overly clever at the expense of emotional depth and authenticity.","Criticizes portrayals that downplay harsh realities, such as slavery, or present an inaccurate, overly idealized North.","Avoids movies with flat jokes, shallow messages, or characters who lack self-belief and conviction.","Dislikes pure ugliness or content with no redeeming substance, preferring meaningful, well-crafted cinema."]}
